WITH
    cohort_users AS (
      SELECT
        profile_id AS userID,
        toDate(min(created_at)) AS cohort_interval
      FROM cohort_events_mv
      WHERE project_id = {p1:String}
        AND name = {p2:String}
        AND created_at >= toDateTime({p3:String})
        AND created_at <= toDateTime({p4:String})
      GROUP BY profile_id
    ),
    last_event AS (
      SELECT
        profile_id,
        toDate(created_at) AS event_date
      FROM cohort_events_mv
      WHERE project_id = {p5:String}
        AND name = {p6:String}
        AND created_at >= toDateTime({p7:String})
        AND created_at <= toDateTime({p8:String}) + INTERVAL {p9:Int64} DAY
    ),
    retention_matrix AS (
      SELECT
        f.cohort_interval,
        l.profile_id,
        dateDiff({p10:String}, f.cohort_interval, toDate(l.event_date)) AS x_after_cohort
      FROM cohort_users AS f
      INNER JOIN last_event AS l ON f.userID = l.profile_id
      WHERE l.event_date >= f.cohort_interval
        AND dateDiff({p11:String}, f.cohort_interval, toDate(l.event_date)) <= {p12:Int64}
    ),
    interval_users AS (
      SELECT
        cohort_interval,
        groupUniqArrayIf(profile_id, x_after_cohort >= {p13:Int64}) AS interval_0_users,
          groupUniqArrayIf(profile_id, x_after_cohort >= {p14:Int64}) AS interval_1_users,
          groupUniqArrayIf(profile_id, x_after_cohort >= {p15:Int64}) AS interval_2_users,

          groupUniqArrayIf(profile_id, x_after_cohort >= {p21:Int64}) AS interval_8_users
      FROM retention_matrix
      GROUP BY cohort_interval
    ),
    cohort_sizes AS (
      SELECT
        cohort_interval,
        COUNT(DISTINCT userID) AS total_first_event_count
      FROM cohort_users
      GROUP BY cohort_interval
    )
    SELECT
      interval_users.cohort_interval AS cohort_interval,
      cs.total_first_event_count AS total_first_event_count,
      length(interval_0_users) AS interval_0_user_count,
          length(interval_1_users) AS interval_1_user_count,

          length(interval_4_users) AS interval_4_user_count,
          length(interval_5_users) AS interval_5_user_count,
          length(interval_6_users) AS interval_6_user_count,
          length(interval_7_users) AS interval_7_user_count,
          length(interval_8_users) AS interval_8_user_count
    FROM interval_users

WITH
    cohort_users AS (
      SELECT
        profile_id AS userID,
        toDate(min(created_at)) AS cohort_interval
      FROM cohort_events_mv
      WHERE project_id = {p1:String}
        AND name = {p2:String}
        AND created_at >= toDateTime({p3:String})
        AND created_at <= toDateTime({p4:String})
      GROUP BY profile_id
    ),
    last_event AS (
      SELECT
        profile_id,
        toDate(created_at) AS event_date
      FROM cohort_events_mv
      WHERE project_id = {p5:String}
        AND name = {p6:String}
        AND created_at >= toDateTime({p7:String})
        AND created_at <= toDateTime({p8:String}) + INTERVAL {p9:Int64} DAY
    ),
    retention_matrix AS (
      SELECT
        f.cohort_interval,
        l.profile_id,
        dateDiff({p10:String}, f.cohort_interval, toDate(l.event_date)) AS x_after_cohort
      FROM cohort_users AS f
      INNER JOIN last_event AS l ON f.userID = l.profile_id
      WHERE l.event_date >= f.cohort_interval
        AND dateDiff({p11:String}, f.cohort_interval, toDate(l.event_date)) <= {p12:Int64}
    ),
    interval_users AS (
      SELECT
        cohort_interval,
        groupUniqArrayIf(profile_id, x_after_cohort = {p13:Int64}) AS interval_0_users,
          groupUniqArrayIf(profile_id, x_after_cohort = {p14:Int64}) AS interval_1_users,
          groupUniqArrayIf(profile_id, x_after_cohort = {p15:Int64}) AS interval_2_users,
          groupUniqArrayIf(profile_id, x_after_cohort = {p16:Int64}) AS interval_3_users,
          groupUniqArrayIf(profile_id, x_after_cohort = {p17:Int64}) AS interval_4_users,
          groupUniqArrayIf(profile_id, x_after_cohort = {p18:Int64}) AS interval_5_users,
          groupUniqArrayIf(profile_id, x_after_cohort = {p19:Int64}) AS interval_6_users,
          groupUniqArrayIf(profile_id, x_after_cohort = {p20:Int64}) AS interval_7_users,
          groupUniqArrayIf(profile_id, x_after_cohort = {p21:Int64}) AS interval_8_users
      FROM retention_matrix
      GROUP BY cohort_interval
    ),
    cohort_sizes AS (
      SELECT
        cohort_interval,
        COUNT(DISTINCT userID) AS total_first_event_count
      FROM cohort_users
      GROUP BY cohort_interval
    )
    SELECT
      interval_users.cohort_interval AS cohort_interval,
      cs.total_first_event_count AS total_first_event_count,
      length(interval_0_users) AS interval_0_user_count,
          length(interval_1_users) AS interval_1_user_count,
          length(interval_2_users) AS interval_2_user_count,
          length(interval_3_users) AS interval_3_user_count,
          length(interval_4_users) AS interval_4_user_count,
          length(interval_5_users) AS interval_5_user_count,
          length(interval_6_users) AS interval_6_user_count,
          length(interval_7_users) AS interval_7_user_count,
          length(interval_8_users) AS interval_8_user_count
    FROM interval_users
    LEFT JOIN cohort_sizes AS cs ON interval_users.cohort_interval = cs.cohort_interval
    ORDER BY cohort_interval ASC 
FORMAT JSON
